module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Fractional Remainder Detection (1.00 Lot Across 3 Equal Accounts)
precondition: Master opens 1.00 lot across 3 accounts ($10k each). Exact math: 0.333333 lots each.
steps: 1. Quantize child lots to 0.01: Acc 1 = 0.33, Acc 2 = 0.33, Acc 3 = 0.33 (Total 0.99 lots).2. Remainder engine identifies unallocated residual: 1.00 - 0.99 = 0.01 lot.
expected: Remainder of exactly 0.01 lot detected; routed to designated remainder policy handler.
coverage_note: Copy-size rounding observed; conserved one-lot division across three accounts and remainder ledger not exercised.
